# Tasks: Unattended Work Continuity

Five all-open canonical units implement the approved Feature 013 definition contract at `.dude/specs/013-unattended-work-continuity/spec.md`. They tighten the existing `dude-work` recovery runtime (`src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs`) and its single detailed prompt (`src/skills/dude-work/SKILL.md`). No new engine, lane, board, command, persistent store, or stop reason is introduced, and no execution state exists yet.

No task carries `[P]`: every runtime task writes the same module (`src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs`) and the same detailed prompt, so no write sets are genuinely disjoint. Every task traces to a plan phase and a spec requirement.

Durable suffixes are the fixed lowercase hexadecimal encodings of `keep`, `name`, `safe`, `docs`, and `revw`.

Execution may read but must not write any `.dude/specs/013-unattended-work-continuity/**` artifact, and must not touch the Feature 005, 009, or 010 packages. A required normative change stops with `contract-mismatch: redefine-required`.

## Phase 1: Continuity Discipline

**Goal**: Under an explicit unattended policy, keep working through ready work and end only on a closed-set stop; a progress report is never a stop.

- [ ] T001@6b656570 [Shared] Inverted default in `src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs` and `src/skills/dude-work/recovery.test.mjs`: under an explicit unattended policy, keep working through ready work and end the loop only on a condition from the existing closed stop set; a turn that carries no closed-set reason (including a progress report) is not a halt and does not end the loop. Update `src/skills/dude-work/SKILL.md` Stops discipline as the single detailed owner. Preserve default and explicit `guarded` behavior byte-for-byte and introduce no new stop reason, lane, board, command, or store. Verify with `node --test src/skills/dude-work/recovery.test.mjs`. (US1, US4 → FR-001, FR-002, FR-009)

## Phase 2: Halt Observability

**Goal**: Every unattended halt echoes exactly one named closed-set reason and carries actionable cause detail; a halt without either fails closed.

- [ ] T002@6e616d65 [Shared] In `src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs` and `src/skills/dude-work/recovery.test.mjs`, require every unattended halt to echo exactly one reason from the existing closed stop set (Feature 005 and Feature 009 settled set) and to carry actionable detail — affected target, the specific subject or condition that caused the stop, and the next owner action — composed from existing Inspection and evidence surfaces; fail closed when a closed-set reason or actionable detail cannot be established rather than emitting a named-but-opaque or unnameable halt. Keep the deterministic runtime the owner of stop detection, named-reason attribution, and the fail-closed decision; model reasoning may only phrase the narrative and establishes no stop, reason, or approval. Reflect the tightened Stops discipline in `src/skills/dude-work/SKILL.md`. Verify with `node --test src/skills/dude-work/recovery.test.mjs`. (US2, US3 → FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-010)
